Source the setup of a report

Source: R/setup.R
source_report_setup.Rd

Sources the file setup.R of a book, from the setup chunk of its chapters. The file is found from the working directory, so the same call works during quarto render (the working directory is the book folder) and when the chunks are run by hand (the working directory is often the project root, or any folder of it).

Usage

source_report_setup(
  report,
  file = "setup.R",
  path_reports = "reports",
  envir = globalenv()
)

Arguments

report

Book folder name, e.g. "04_run-intellirrig_fr".

file

Name of the setup file.

path_reports

Folder containing the book folders.

envir

Environment where the file is evaluated. By default the global environment, where the chunks of a chapter are evaluated, so the objects it creates are available in the chunks.

Value

The path of the sourced file, invisibly.

Details

The file is searched in each folder from the working directory up to the root of the file system: first file in the folder itself when it is named report, then path_reports/report/file. The first one found is sourced.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile()
dir.create(file.path(tmp, "reports", "rapport"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines("setup_done <- TRUE", file.path(tmp, "reports/rapport/setup.R"))
withr::with_dir(tmp, source_report_setup("rapport", envir = environment()))
setup_done
#> [1] TRUE
